tailscale.visibility: Allow visible tailnet devices to request a connection to this server. Access lasts while this server runs. Tailscale HTTPS and access rules must already be configured. Each first connection still requires your approval.
tailscale.unsupported: This server does not support Tailscale connections. Use Add server or SSH setup.
tailscale.workerIntent: Register a separate outbound Worker on this device for the selected server. Existing Workers keep their own lifetimes.
tailscale.matchingCode: Confirm the matching code on both devices.
tailscale.help: Choose a visible device. Online status does not prove DeliDev availability or grant trust.
tailscale.approvalHelp: The target desktop must approve this exact request. Compare the confirmation code before allowing it.
tailscale.completedHelp: Open a paired client from Saved servers. Registered Workers are managed through Runner Devices.
tailscale.loginRequired.heading: Tailscale login is required.
tailscale.loginRequired.body: Open Tailscale on this computer and sign in. Then refresh Tailscale devices and inspect the original access request.
tailscale.retainedRequestHelp: An earlier request for this connection may have been accepted. Retry that original request before sending another.
